operations.description: Delete a currently logged in user account. Behind the scene, the user record is not deleted but permanently blocked from any access. This is done to avoid deleted accounts being overtaken by new users with the same email address. Any user-related resources like documents or storage files should be deleted separately.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] account delete [PATH] account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Delete all sessions from the user account and remove any sessions cookies from the end client.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] account delete sessions [PATH] account sessions [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Use this endpoint to log out the currently logged in user from all their account sessions across all of their different devices. When using the option id argument, only the session unique ID provider will be deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] account delete session [PATH] account sessions [PARAMS] id session [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Delete a document by its unique ID. This endpoint deletes only the parent documents, its attributes and relations to other documents. Child documents **will not** be deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] database delete document [PATH] database collections documents [PARAMS] collection document id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Delete a file by its unique ID. Only users with write permissions have access to delete this resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] storage delete file [PATH] storage files [PARAMS] file id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Delete a team by its unique ID. Only team owners have write access for this resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] teams delete [PATH] teams [PARAMS] id team [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This endpoint allows a user to leave a team or for a team owner to delete the membership of any other team member. You can also use this endpoint to delete a user membership even if it is not accepted.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] teams delete membership [PATH] teams memberships [PARAMS] id membership team [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get currently logged in user data as JSON object.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account [PATH] account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Get currently logged in user list of latest security activity logs. Each log returns user IP address, location and date and time of log.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account logs [PATH] account logs [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] list log

operations.description: Get currently logged in user preferences as a key-value object.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account prefs [PATH] account prefs [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences

operations.description: Get currently logged in user list of active sessions across different devices.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account sessions [PATH] account sessions [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] list session

operations.description:
Allow the user to login to their account using the OAuth2 provider of their choice. Each OAuth2 provider should be enabled from the Appwrite console first. Use the success and failure arguments to provide a redirect URL's back to your app when login is completed.

If there is already an active session, the new session will be attached to the logged-in account. If there are no active sessions, the server will attempt to look for a user with the same email address as the email received from the OAuth2 provider and attach the new session to the existing user. If no matching user is found - the server will create a new user..
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account create oauth 2 session [PATH] account sessions oauth 2 [PARAMS] failure provider scopes success [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Use this endpoint to get a logged in user's session using a Session ID. Inputting 'current' will return the current session being used.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account session [PATH] account sessions [PARAMS] id session [SCHEMA] session

operations.description: You can use this endpoint to show different browser icons to your users. The code argument receives the browser code as it appears in your user /account/sessions endpoint. Use width, height and quality arguments to change the output settings.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars browser [PATH] avatars browsers [PARAMS] code height quality width [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The credit card endpoint will return you the icon of the credit card provider you need. Use width, height and quality arguments to change the output settings.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars credit card [PATH] avatars credit cards [PARAMS] code height quality width [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Use this endpoint to fetch the favorite icon (AKA favicon) of any remote website URL.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars favicon [PATH] avatars favicon [PARAMS] url [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can use this endpoint to show different country flags icons to your users. The code argument receives the 2 letter country code. Use width, height and quality arguments to change the output settings.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars flag [PATH] avatars flags [PARAMS] code height quality width [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Use this endpoint to fetch a remote image URL and crop it to any image size you want. This endpoint is very useful if you need to crop and display remote images in your app or in case you want to make sure a 3rd party image is properly served using a TLS protocol.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars image [PATH] avatars image [PARAMS] height url width [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to show your user initials avatar icon on your website or app. By default, this route will try to print your logged-in user name or email initials. You can also overwrite the user name if you pass the 'name' parameter. If no name is given and no user is logged, an empty avatar will be returned.

You can use the color and background params to change the avatar colors. By default, a random theme will be selected. The random theme will persist for the user's initials when reloading the same theme will always return for the same initials.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars initials [PATH] avatars initials [PARAMS] background color height name width [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Converts a given plain text to a QR code image. You can use the query parameters to change the size and style of the resulting image.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] avatars qr [PATH] avatars qr [PARAMS] download margin size text [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of all the user documents. You can use the query params to filter your results. On admin mode, this endpoint will return a list of all of the project's documents. [Learn more about different API modes](/docs/admin).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] database list documents [PATH] database collections documents [PARAMS] cast collection field filters id limit offset order search type [SCHEMA] document list permissions

operations.description: Get a document by its unique ID. This endpoint response returns a JSON object with the document data.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] database document [PATH] database collections documents [PARAMS] collection document id [SCHEMA] document permissions

operations.description: Get a list of all the current user function execution logs. You can use the query params to filter your results. On admin mode, this endpoint will return a list of all of the project's executions. [Learn more about different API modes](/docs/admin).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] functions list executions [PATH] functions executions [PARAMS] function id limit offset order search type [SCHEMA] execution list

operations.description: Get a function execution log by its unique ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] functions execution [PATH] functions executions [PARAMS] execution function id [SCHEMA] execution

operations.description:
Get the current user location based on IP. Returns an object with user country code, country name, continent name, continent code, ip address and suggested currency. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.

([IP Geolocation by DB-IP](https://db-ip.com))
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale [PATH] locale [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] locale

operations.description: List of all continents. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale continents [PATH] locale continents [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] continent list

operations.description: List of all countries. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale countries [PATH] locale countries [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] country list

operations.description: List of all countries that are currently members of the EU. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale countries eu [PATH] locale countries eu [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] country list

operations.description: List of all countries phone codes. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale countries phones [PATH] locale countries phones [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] list phone

operations.description: List of all currencies, including currency symbol, name, plural, and decimal digits for all major and minor currencies. You can use the locale header to get the data in a supported language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale currencies [PATH] locale currencies [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] currency list

operations.description: List of all languages classified by ISO 639-1 including 2-letter code, name in English, and name in the respective language.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] locale languages [PATH] locale languages [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] language list

operations.description: Get a list of all the user files. You can use the query params to filter your results. On admin mode, this endpoint will return a list of all of the project's files. [Learn more about different API modes](/docs/admin).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] storage list files [PATH] storage files [PARAMS] limit offset order search type [SCHEMA] file list permissions

operations.description: Get a file by its unique ID. This endpoint response returns a JSON object with the file metadata.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] storage file [PATH] storage files [PARAMS] file id [SCHEMA] file permissions

operations.description: Get a file content by its unique ID. The endpoint response return with a 'Content-Disposition: attachment' header that tells the browser to start downloading the file to user downloads directory.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] storage file download [PATH] storage files download [PARAMS] file id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a file preview image. Currently, this method supports preview for image files (jpg, png, and gif), other supported formats, like pdf, docs, slides, and spreadsheets, will return the file icon image. You can also pass query string arguments for cutting and resizing your preview image.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] storage file preview [PATH] storage files preview [PARAMS] background border color file gravity height id opacity output quality radius rotation width [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a file content by its unique ID. This endpoint is similar to the download method but returns with no  'Content-Disposition: attachment' header.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] storage file view [PATH] storage files view [PARAMS] file id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of all the current user teams. You can use the query params to filter your results. On admin mode, this endpoint will return a list of all of the project's teams. [Learn more about different API modes](/docs/admin).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] teams list [PATH] teams [PARAMS] limit offset order search type [SCHEMA] list team

operations.description: Get a team by its unique ID. All team members have read access for this resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] teams [PATH] teams [PARAMS] id team [SCHEMA] team

operations.description: Get a team members by the team unique ID. All team members have read access for this list of resources.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] teams memberships [PATH] teams memberships [PARAMS] id limit offset order search team type [SCHEMA] list membership

operations.description:
Update currently logged in user account email address. After changing user address, user confirmation status is being reset and a new confirmation mail is sent. For security measures, user password is required to complete this request.
This endpoint can also be used to convert an anonymous account to a normal one, by passing an email address and a new password.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] account update email [PATH] account email [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Update currently logged in user account name.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] account update name [PATH] account name [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Update currently logged in user password. For validation, user is required to pass in the new password, and the old password. For users created with OAuth and Team Invites, oldPassword is optional.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] account update password [PATH] account password [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Update currently logged in user account preferences. You can pass only the specific settings you wish to update.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] account update prefs [PATH] account prefs [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Update a document by its unique ID. Using the patch method you can pass only specific fields that will get updated.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] database update document [PATH] database collections documents [PARAMS] collection document id [SCHEMA] document permissions
[METHOD] patch [NAME] teams update membership roles [PATH] teams memberships [PARAMS] id membership team [SCHEMA] membership

operations.description: Use this endpoint to allow a user to accept an invitation to join a team after being redirected back to your app from the invitation email recieved by the user.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] teams update membership status [PATH] teams memberships status [PARAMS] id membership team [SCHEMA] membership

operations.description: Use this endpoint to allow a new user to register a new account in your project. After the user registration completes successfully, you can use the [/account/verfication](/docs/client/account#accountCreateVerification) route to start verifying the user email address. To allow the new user to login to their new account, you need to create a new [account session](/docs/client/account#accountCreateSession).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create [PATH] account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] preferences user

operations.description: Use this endpoint to create a JSON Web Token. You can use the resulting JWT to authenticate on behalf of the current user when working with the Appwrite server-side API and SDKs. The JWT secret is valid for 15 minutes from its creation and will be invalid if the user will logout in that time frame.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create jwt [PATH] account jwt [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] jwt

operations.description: Sends the user an email with a temporary secret key for password reset. When the user clicks the confirmation link he is redirected back to your app password reset URL with the secret key and email address values attached to the URL query string. Use the query string params to submit a request to the [PUT /account/recovery](/docs/client/account#accountUpdateRecovery) endpoint to complete the process. The verification link sent to the user's email address is valid for 1 hour.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create recovery [PATH] account recovery [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] token

operations.description: Allow the user to login into their account by providing a valid email and password combination. This route will create a new session for the user.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create session [PATH] account sessions [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] session

operations.description: Use this endpoint to allow a new user to register an anonymous account in your project. This route will also create a new session for the user. To allow the new user to convert an anonymous account to a normal account, you need to update its [email and password](/docs/client/account#accountUpdateEmail) or create an [OAuth2 session](/docs/client/account#accountCreateOAuth2Session).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create anonymous session [PATH] account sessions anonymous [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] session

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to send a verification message to your user email address to confirm they are the valid owners of that address. Both the **userId** and **secret** arguments will be passed as query parameters to the URL you have provided to be attached to the verification email. The provided URL should redirect the user back to your app and allow you to complete the verification process by verifying both the **userId** and **secret** parameters. Learn more about how to [complete the verification process](/docs/client/account#accountUpdateVerification). The verification link sent to the user's email address is valid for 7 days.

Please note that in order to avoid a [Redirect Attack](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/blob/master/cheatsheets/Unvalidated_Redirects_and_Forwards_Cheat_Sheet.md), the only valid redirect URLs are the ones from domains you have set when adding your platforms in the console interface.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] account create verification [PATH] account verification [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] token

operations.description: Create a new Document. Before using this route, you should create a new collection resource using either a [server integration](/docs/server/database#databaseCreateCollection) API or directly from your database console.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] database create document [PATH] database collections documents [PARAMS] collection id [SCHEMA] document permissions

operations.description: Trigger a function execution. The returned object will return you the current execution status. You can ping the `Get Execution` endpoint to get updates on the current execution status. Once this endpoint is called, your function execution process will start asynchronously.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] functions create execution [PATH] functions executions [PARAMS] function id [SCHEMA] execution

operations.description: Create a new file. The user who creates the file will automatically be assigned to read and write access unless he has passed custom values for read and write arguments.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] storage create file [PATH] storage files [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] file permissions

operations.description: Create a new team. The user who creates the team will automatically be assigned as the owner of the team. The team owner can invite new members, who will be able add new owners and update or delete the team from your project.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] teams create [PATH] teams [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] team

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to invite a new member to join your team. If initiated from Client SDK, an email with a link to join the team will be sent to the new member's email address if the member doesn't exist in the project it will be created automatically. If initiated from server side SDKs, new member will automatically be added to the team.

Use the 'URL' parameter to redirect the user from the invitation email back to your app. When the user is redirected, use the [Update Team Membership Status](/docs/client/teams#teamsUpdateMembershipStatus) endpoint to allow the user to accept the invitation to the team.  While calling from side SDKs the redirect url can be empty string.

Please note that in order to avoid a [Redirect Attacks](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/blob/master/cheatsheets/Unvalidated_Redirects_and_Forwards_Cheat_Sheet.md) the only valid redirect URL's are the once from domains you have set when added your platforms in the console interface.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] teams create membership [PATH] teams memberships [PARAMS] id team [SCHEMA] membership

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to complete the user account password reset. Both the **userId** and **secret** arguments will be passed as query parameters to the redirect URL you have provided when sending your request to the [POST /account/recovery](/docs/client/account#accountCreateRecovery) endpoint.

Please note that in order to avoid a [Redirect Attack](https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/blob/master/cheatsheets/Unvalidated_Redirects_and_Forwards_Cheat_Sheet.md) the only valid redirect URLs are the ones from domains you have set when adding your platforms in the console interface.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] account update recovery [PATH] account recovery [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] token

operations.description: Use this endpoint to complete the user email verification process. Use both the **userId** and **secret** parameters that were attached to your app URL to verify the user email ownership. If confirmed this route will return a 200 status code.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] account update verification [PATH] account verification [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] token

operations.description: Update a file by its unique ID. Only users with write permissions have access to update this resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] storage update file [PATH] storage files [PARAMS] file id [SCHEMA] file permissions

operations.description: Update a team by its unique ID. Only team owners have write access for this resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] teams update [PATH] teams [PARAMS] id team [SCHEMA] team
